name: Does HH Remodeling handle painting and drywall repairs along with trim work?

mainEntity.name: Does HH Remodeling handle painting and drywall repairs along with trim work?

acceptedAnswer.text: HH Remodeling provides complete, start-to-finish finish carpentry services led by owner and hands-on contractor Abraham Becerra. Because our crew handles custom framing, drywall repair, finish carpentry, and interior painting directly, you do not need to hire separate trades to patch drywall behind old trim or paint newly installed moldings. Abraham serves as your direct point of contact and on-site lead throughout the project. We install baseboards, door and window casings, crown molding, and custom accents across Aurora, Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, and Parker.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. HH Remodeling handles the complete scope in-house, including trim removal, drywall repairs, precision carpentry, caulking, and final interior painting.
